decisions.reason: In treatise formula 於左 points to the following tables, not a spatial left; 'below' matches that sense and the following ready-reckoner methods.
一千四百四十年 is the single numeral 1,440 years; '1,400 forty years' misreads the Chinese and obscures the total.
一千四百四十年 is 1,440 years; replacing the broken '1,400 forty years' restores the correct year total.
一千四百四十年 is 1,440 years; the proposed numeral matches the Chinese and the parallel idiomatic reading.
Received 小月一宮十牙度四分 is corrupt; the Siku Mingshi monthly doubled-separation entry and the parallel daily table both read 十一宮十七度四分, so short month is 11 signs 17°04′, not 1 sign.
